critical_code_review_comments: AIAssistant.jsx line 68 still uses index i to gate the '…' placeholder; this is functionally fine now, but the placeholder is redundant because the streaming loop already mutates the last assistant bubble's text on the first chunk. Consider simplifying to `m.role==='assistant' && !m.text && busy ? '…' : ''` to remove the i dependency entirely and future-proof against similar refactors.
